audit.title: Pearl Voice Cue Inventory
scope: Shared setup, camera readiness, countdown, speech playback, safety, and generated audio assets

generatedVoiceAssets.note: The MP3 count is higher than template count because num-0 through num-40 are individual generated assets per voice, while this inventory counts them as one dynamic cue template.

nonSpeechAudio.note: Rep-credit sound effect, not a spoken voice cue.

speechImplementation.generator: scripts/generate-audio.ts uses ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 at build/generation time only.
speechImplementation.interruptionPolicy: One cue sequence at a time. Lower/equal-priority speak() calls are dropped while busy; higher-priority speak() calls stop current speech and start the new sequence.
speechImplementation.missingAssetPolicy: Logs a warning and skips to the next cue in the sequence.
